name: carpet-vo-1
text: You paid for twelve hundred square feet. [short pause] So why can you only walk on about nine hundred and twenty? Grab a tape. Wall to wall, room by room... that's your carpet area. The brochure uses a bigger number. Super built-up area. It adds your walls... plus your share of the lobby, the lifts, the stairs... even the clubhouse pool. That extra is called loading. Often around thirty percent. So twelve hundred, with thirty percent loading... is about nine twenty you can actually stand on. Now the money. At one crore, that's about eighty-three hundred rupees a foot on paper... [pause] and nearly eleven thousand a foot for the floor you live on. Under RERA, carpet area is the legal measure. So ask one question first: what's the carpet area? Would you rather pay for the lobby... or your living room?
